title: Clean up the Rust workspace, add Rust CI and point agents at the guidelines
body:
This repairs the Rust cleanup against current main while preserving the newer bounded-source API and independent oracle expectations. It consolidates shared FENS verification and pinned SRS constants, preserves ledger refusal codes through SDK error wrapping, boxes large diagnostics/outcomes, and removes duplicate test-module mounts.

The integration restores both frozen normal-oracle JSON files to main's exact bytes. It also extends the ledger's declared source list to cover all 64 current Sherlock Rust files: the original 35 plus 29 added since the first PR candidate. The 61-file baseline and eight-file Core-stage append remain unchanged. Together with six declared backend paths, the list has 139 entries. These membership checks do not authenticate the complete Rust dependency graph or establish proof correctness.

The Rust workflow is manual only, matching the user's local-CI policy. Compile writes `source-projection.json` before the final `artifact.json` completion marker. Four incoming example binding-hash updates are retained but remain unvalidated by compiler/runtime execution. Source changes invalidate affected prior review, deployment and key identities; no keys or proof artifacts were regenerated.

Validation for this integrated candidate is limited to source inspection, Git/Python metadata checks and the recorded ten ordinary plugin-guidance tests. Independent ordinary and scoped security reviews are for draft source publication only. Cargo compilation, formatting, clippy, workspace tests and all native/SDK/proof/ledger checks remain UNRUN. The original author's macOS 890-test result belongs to the older `0861c75254f33b92194db0542f224215d47269a8` candidate and does not validate this integration. The user requested merge and fresh ordinary plus Opus 4.8 reviews approve source-only integration. Rust, native and ledger acceptance remain open.

The [doctorwatson<UTXO> / doctormoriarty<utxo> intake](https://github.com/CharlesHoskinson/Moriarty/blob/utxo/docs/utxo/doctorwatson/github/work-items.json) tracks this PR and issues #76–#89 against the applicable EARS and remaining checks. [Current publication receipts and review scope](https://github.com/CharlesHoskinson/Moriarty/blob/utxo/docs/utxo/doctorwatson/github/GITHUB-PUBLICATION.json) distinguish historical captures from later updates. Source publication does not close compiler, financial, proof or target-ledger requirements. Native authority remains zero; the broader Preprod goal remains paused.

Source-only merge disposition: ordinary Sherlock reporting QA passed 230 tests and plugin guidance passed 10. Cargo/Rust compilation and runtime tests, SDK/proof checks and ledger execution remain UNRUN. No native resource counter or EARS/product acceptance is reset. The optional SDK-linked Cargo test was not admitted by the security reviewer.
